''See also: [[The Way Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Way]], also known as [[Way|the Way]] Between [[Worlds]], is a fundamental force of pure order that governs reality and maintains stability across all [[Iterations]]. Often described as a network of veins or a branching [[labyrinth]] of blue light, it serves as the connective tissue between different worlds. It provides protection from the chaos of the void and ensures the proper flow of time, though its connection to a world can be severed, leaving that world adrift. The [[Way]] is characterized by its [[sapphire]] or azure appearance, often manifesting as flowing ribbons, tunnels, or corridors that allow for travel between distant locations. Sentient beings draw power from [[Way|the Way]], and their lives act as anchors that tie worlds to it. Those with significant potential may be considered [[Waybound]], indicating they are destined to have a major impact on the cosmos. The [[Abidan]] serve as guardians or jailers within this system, utilizing its properties to enforce natural laws and maintain order. At the very center of [[Way|the Way]] lies [[Oversight]], the nexus of all existence. While many practitioners follow specific [[Paths]] within the [[sacred arts]], these individual journeys are ultimately part of the broader structure of [[Way|the Way]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Way]] is a dimension that can be accessed through the use of portals and serves as a location where Ozriel's [[Authority|authority]] spills over. During a confrontation, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] cautioned [[Yerin]] that she was effectively casting herself into this realm. Before [[Lindon]]'s eventual ascension, it became necessary to re-establish control over the dimension. Ultimately, [[Lindon]] and [[Fury]] prepared to enter [[Way|the Way]], though it felt distant during this particular iteration.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] warned [[Yerin]] that she was casting herself into [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Way]] is a dimension that can be accessed via portals.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Control over [[Way|the Way]] needs to be re-established before [[Lindon]] ascends.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Way]] is a place [[Lindon]] and [[Fury]] prepare to enter.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Way]] feels distant in this iteration.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c38">''Waybound'', chapter 38</ref>}}</li>
